name: cuehq-mcp
description: run the cuehq mcp server as a local command: a stdio bridge to https://www.cuehq.social/mcp for agents that start mcp servers themselves.

scripts.check-version: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version,s=require('./server.json'),q=String.fromCharCode(39),i=require('fs').readFileSync('src/index.ts','utf8');if(s.version!==v||s.packages[0].version!==v||!i.includes('VERSION = '+q+v+q))throw new Error('version mismatch, expected '+v);console.log('version '+v+' agrees in package.json, server.json and src/index.ts')"
scripts.prepack: npm run check-version && npm run build
